description: The Ogre King's trophy tusk and the iron he hoarded (one of the Valley's five ingots); B2: his titan parts - his hide (four cuts), the crown's iron and the bell's bronze; each trophy broken in the fight that kills him adds its own (data/enemies/ogre_king.json plates[].loot: a second crown-iron, a second bell-bronze, wood from the wheels). Thornwick's smithy works them once he has fallen (the Kingsfall set).
